name: abletime
description: Record time and run the AbleTime board.

interface.shortDescription: Record time and run the board
interface.longDescription: AbleTime records time and runs the project board from one MCP connection that also serves reports as a share link. Skills cover recording, intake, sorting, a bugfix pull request, the board, reports, and a walkthrough. Session-bound watch polling and lifecycle hooks ship only in the Codex marketplace package, not in this hook-free OpenAI package.
defaultPrompt: Record the time on the work I am doing.
Give me a share link for this week's hours.

positive.description: List active tasks assigned to me in the OpenAI Review project
positive.prompt: Show my active tasks assigned to me in the OpenAI Review project.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve identity and the OpenAI Review project, then return only matching active tasks assigned to the reviewer.

positive.description: Record twenty-five minutes on the OpenAI plugin review task
positive.prompt: Record 25 minutes against the task titled OpenAI plugin review for checking the submission package.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one linked draft with wall-clock entryDate, twenty-five minutes, and source/sourceKey provenance against that task.

positive.description: Set the OpenAI priority test task to high
positive.prompt: Set the OpenAI priority test task to high priority.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the named task and change only that task's priority to high.

positive.description: Add the OpenAI review checkpoint comment
positive.prompt: Add the comment 'OpenAI review checkpoint complete' to the OpenAI comment test task.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the OpenAI comment test task and add exactly one comment with that text.

positive.description: Create an hours report share link for 21–27 September 2026
positive.prompt: Create an hours report for 21–27 September 2026 and give me the share link.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the expiring AbleTime report path and coverage gaps without dumping the report document.

negative.description: Refuse to record time without a task or usable context
negative.prompt: Record time for the work I just did.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask which task to use. Do not create an entry and do not guess a task.

negative.description: Refuse to invent a project that is not visible
negative.prompt: Create a task in the Northwind project.
negative.expected_behavior: Report that Northwind cannot be resolved in the review organization. Do not choose another project.
With agent acceptance disabled, relay the refusal once, do not retry, and leave the draft unchanged.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.0 hook-free OpenAI package: one MCP connection at /api/public/v2/mcp/plugins, restored recording workflows, and OpenAI review cases. Watch automation remains Codex-marketplace-only.
